objetivo: una rutina hacible: ducha, luz, espejo, alguien para la espalda, fotos con moneda, el vaso en el botiquín

momentos.p: Once a month, after a shower, stand in good light in front of a mirror.
momentos.porque: 'una vez por mes, después de la ducha, con buena luz' → el señor en bata frente al espejo empañado
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 72-year-old man in a terry bathrobe opened at the chest standing in front of a large bathroom mirror still slightly steamed at the edges after a shower, wiping a clear patch with his hand, bright daylight from a window beside the mirror, a towel hanging over the shower door, a bathmat, a plant on the windowsill, a toothbrush cup
momentos.motion: his hand wipes the steam off the mirror in a slow arc

momentos.p: ask someone you trust to look at your back
momentos.porque: 'pedile a alguien de confianza que te mire la espalda' → la esposa revisándole la espalda con la linterna del celular
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 70-year-old wife standing behind her husband who sits on the edge of their bed with his t-shirt pulled up to his shoulders, she shines her phone flashlight on his back dotted with small red spots and points at one with a pen, both calm and chatting, a nightstand with a lamp, a quilt, a dresser with photos, afternoon light
momentos.motion: the phone flashlight moves slowly across his back

momentos.p: You're not counting the red dots.
momentos.porque: 'no estás contando los puntos' → él riéndose, tachando con la mano una lista de números
momentos.prompt: sitting at his desk laughing softly and pushing aside a notepad covered with tally marks, shaking his head with an amused grin, a hand mirror on the desk, a coffee mug, a stethoscope around his neck, bookshelf with plant, framed mountain print, daylight
momentos.motion: he slides the notepad away and shakes his head with a laugh

momentos.p: Take one picture of your chest and one of your back
momentos.porque: 'sacate una foto del pecho y una de la espalda' → el señor sacándose foto frente al espejo
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a 68-year-old man in his bedroom with his shirt off holding a smartphone at chest height and taking a photo of his chest in the closet mirror, the phone's back facing the mirror, concentrated expression with his tongue slightly between his lips, a bed with a folded shirt on it, a lamp, a laundry basket, window daylight
momentos.motion: his thumb taps the phone and he checks the photo

momentos.p: with a coin next to it for size
momentos.porque: 'con una moneda al lado para el tamaño' → la moneda de un cuarto junto al punto
momentos.prompt: close shot of a US quarter coin held flat against the skin of an older man's upper arm right next to a small round cherry-red dot, his thumb and finger holding the coin, freckles and fine hairs, the sleeve of a white t-shirt pushed up, a smartphone's rounded corner at the edge of the frame, bright window light
momentos.motion: the fingers settle the coin closer to the dot

momentos.p: Next month, take the same pictures and compare.
momentos.porque: 'el mes que viene, las mismas fotos y comparás' → la pareja comparando dos fotos en el celular
momentos.prompt: medium shot of an older couple sitting side by side at their kitchen table, the husband holding a smartphone with a dark screen reflection, the wife leaning in with her reading glasses on, both focused and comparing, a spiral notebook with dates, a pen, two cups of coffee, a plate of cookies, a window with morning light
momentos.motion: he swipes on the phone and she leans closer

momentos.p: very easy to see in a photo
momentos.porque: 'muy fácil de ver en una foto' → la misma moneda junto al mismo punto un mes después
momentos.prompt: close shot of a US quarter coin held against the upper arm of an older man next to the same small round cherry-red dot, photographed a month later in the same window light, a thin pen circle drawn on the skin around the dot, the sleeve of a white t-shirt, freckles and fine hairs
momentos.motion: the fingers hold the coin steady while the light brightens a little

momentos.p: Keep a clear glass in the bathroom cabinet.
momentos.porque: 'guardá un vaso en el botiquín' → el botiquín abierto con el vaso limpio en el estante
momentos.prompt: medium shot of an open mirrored bathroom medicine cabinet with a single clean clear drinking glass on the middle shelf next to a box of adhesive bandages, a thermometer, a roll of gauze and a small pair of scissors, an older woman's hand placing the glass, white tiles, morning window light
momentos.motion: the hand sets the glass on the shelf and the mirror door swings a little

momentos.porque: 'apretá el vaso' → la mano presionando el vaso contra puntitos del tobillo en el baño
momentos.prompt: close shot of an older woman's hand pressing a clear drinking glass against the inside of her ankle over a few tiny red dots while she sits on the closed toilet lid, a pink bath mat, a slipper, the edge of a white tub, bathroom light
momentos.motion: the glass presses down and the skin around it whitens

momentos.p: If they don't fade, you know what to do.
momentos.porque: 'si no se borran, ya sabés qué hacer' → él levantando el teléfono, mirada firme y cálida
momentos.prompt: standing by his desk holding up the handset of the office phone toward the camera with a firm, warm look and a small nod, a clear glass on the desk beside a stethoscope, a stack of charts, a desk lamp, bookshelf with plant, framed mountain print, daylight
momentos.motion: he lifts the phone a little and nods once

componentes.p: So let's put this into a simple routine.
componentes.title: The monthly skin check
componentes.desc: once a month, after a shower, good light

objetivo: la foto grande, la guía en la descripción, educación, suscribirse

momentos.p: your skin has been around for a while
momentos.porque: 'tu piel ya tiene sus años' → pareja mayor al sol en el lago, tranquila
momentos.prompt: wide shot of a 74-year-old husband and wife sitting on the edge of a wooden lake dock with their feet in the water, he in an open short-sleeved shirt with a few red dots on his chest, she in a sun hat, both laughing, a thermos and two mugs between them, a fishing rod leaning on a post, pine trees, sparkling water, golden late afternoon light
momentos.motion: their feet kick the water gently and the ripples spread

momentos.p: they share the neighborhood with a few spots that are serious
momentos.porque: 'comparten el barrio con unos pocos serios' → muchos puntitos rojos y una lesión rara entre ellos, con la lupa
momentos.prompt: close shot of an older man's upper back under a round magnifying lamp, many small round red cherry dots and freckles and one irregular dark pink crusted bump among them circled lightly with a surgical skin marker, a gloved hand holding the marker, the edge of a paper gown, clinic light
momentos.motion: the marker finishes the circle around the odd bump

momentos.p: print it for your bathroom mirror
momentos.porque: 'imprimila para el espejo del baño' → una hojita pegada con cinta al borde del espejo
momentos.prompt: medium shot of a bathroom mirror with a single printed checklist sheet taped to its lower corner with blue painter's tape, an older woman's hand smoothing the tape, a clear glass on the shelf below, a toothbrush cup, a hand towel, white tiles, bright morning light
momentos.motion: her hand presses the tape flat and the page settles

momentos.p: share it with someone who has been quietly counting red dots in the mirror
momentos.porque: 'compartilo con alguien que cuenta puntitos en silencio' → dos amigos jubilados en el café, uno le muestra el celular al otro
momentos.prompt: medium shot of two retired men in their seventies at a small diner counter, one holding out his phone with a dark screen toward the other and tapping his own chest with a knowing grin, the friend raising his eyebrows and laughing, cups of coffee, a slice of pie, a sugar dispenser, a napkin holder, a chrome counter, morning window light
momentos.motion: he taps his chest and his friend leans in laughing
